name: sagemath-mcp-server
description: MCP server providing symbolic mathematics via SageMath computer algebra system
author: Justice

skills.name: symbolic-math
skills.description: Domain knowledge for symbolic mathematics, algebraic manipulation, calculus, and number theory using SageMath

commands.name: evaluate
commands.description: Execute arbitrary SageMath expressions and return the computed result

commands.name: solve-equation
commands.description: Solve algebraic and transcendental equations symbolically

commands.name: differentiate
commands.description: Compute derivatives of mathematical expressions (partial, higher-order)

commands.name: integrate
commands.description: Compute indefinite and definite integrals of mathematical expressions

commands.name: simplify
commands.description: Simplify mathematical expressions using algebraic rules and trigonometric identities

commands.name: matrix-ops
commands.description: Perform matrix operations: determinant, inverse, eigenvalues, rank, RREF

commands.name: plot
commands.description: Generate plots of mathematical functions and return as base64-encoded PNG image

commands.name: latex-convert
commands.description: Convert mathematical expressions to LaTeX notation for document preparation

commands.name: number-theory
commands.description: Perform number theory calculations: primality, factorization, divisor functions, and more
